source: King's Game - Combat Profiles (Google Sheet): Character Roster, Skills & Traits, and Equipment tabs. These are the Arbiter's combat TEST profiles. Every value is editable in the app.

skills.name: Warrior
skills.description: Warriors use primitive combat techniques and can handle any primitive weapon competently. They are adept with primitive weapons, allowing them to use the T1 Skill Die, d6.
skills.limitation: Warriors cannot add their Skill Bonus to weapon attacks.

skills.name: Spear Warrior
skills.description: Spear Warriors focus specifically on the use of spears. They are adept with spears and may add their Skill Bonus to attacks made with them, trading broad weapon familiarity for focused mastery.

skills.name: Protector
skills.description: Protectors fight with spear and shield, shifting between offense and defense. They are adept with both.
skills.skillFeature: Each turn, a Protector chooses to add their Skill Bonus to either one spear attack or their Defense while bracing. They cannot apply it to both in the same turn.

skills.name: Dagger Warrior
skills.description: Dagger Warriors specialize in knives and daggers in close combat, favoring swift slashes, stabs, and rapid combinations. They may add their Skill Bonus to close-combat dagger or knife attacks.
skills.skillFeature: While wielding a dagger or knife in each hand, they may make two close-combat attacks with a single Action.
skills.limitation: This Skill gives no Stealth benefit and does not apply its Skill Die or Skill Bonus when throwing daggers or knives.

skills.name: Scavenger of Averus
skills.description: Inner Monster Skill carried by Vultures, Levels 1-10, normal Skill Bonus progression (Lv1 +0 through Lv10 +9), no direct combat bonus. It cannot receive Experience; it must feed. The Vulture devours objects and living beings into Essence; each unit of Essence is 1 Value in the Vault, and total current Value sets the Level. Spending Essence can drop the Level. Value thresholds: Lv1 100 | Lv2 250 | Lv3 500 | Lv4 1,000 | Lv5 10,000 | Lv6 50,000 | Lv7 100,000 | Lv8 1,000,000 | Lv9 100,000,000 | Lv10 1,000,000,000. Vault max 1,000,000,000 Essence. Skill Bonus applies to greed, value and acquisition activities, its own functions and techniques, and tasks directly involving Darkness or Darkness Force; not a general Attack, Defense, Power or Damage bonus.
skills.skillFeature: Devour matter into Essence; store Essence in the Vault; spend Essence on deals and pacts; use Essence and Black Stone to carve runes and empower totemic items; spend Essence to develop Vulture Vault Body Types.
skills.limitation: Level is not permanent; it follows current Vault Value.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.description: X has developed an exceptional sense of balance, coordination, and bodily control. They seem to move around danger with an ease that makes their motions difficult to predict.
traits.narrativeFeature: X is unusually graceful and responsive in situations where precise movement, balance, or rapid bodily adjustment matters. The Arbiter determines when Nimble is relevant.
traits.mechanicalFeature: When Nimble applies, X may increase either Attack or Defense by 10%, rounded up, minimum +1. The Attack option only applies while using a Light or Flourish weapon.

traits.name: Flexible
traits.description: X has developed an unusually limber body and excellent control over how they bend, twist, and recover from awkward positions. Movements that would strain or restrict others come naturally to them.
traits.narrativeFeature: Flexible changes what X can reasonably accomplish with their body, especially when squeezing through tight spaces, contorting themselves, recovering from awkward positions, or performing similar feats.
traits.mechanicalFeature: Flexible currently grants no permanent numerical modifier. Any benefit is determined by the Arbiter based on the situation.

traits.name: Weak Danger Premonition
traits.description: X has developed this Trait after developing the Iron Scout Body. They possess a faint premonition of danger, though they have no conscious control over it. Most of the time it is little more than an uneasy feeling, only becoming clear when their life is genuinely threatened.
traits.narrativeFeature: When X is in a life-threatening position, they receive a bad feeling warning them that danger is present. The feeling does not reveal the source or nature of the threat. The Arbiter determines what counts as a life-threatening position.
traits.mechanicalFeature: When this Trait triggers, X gains the Alarmed Condition until the danger is discovered or enough time has passed for them to calm down.

traits.name: Infernal
traits.description: Granted by the Radiant Vault Body Type.

traits.name: Pact of the Continuing Shot
traits.description: X has decided to swear the Pact of the Continuing Shot, binding their momentum to the accuracy of each ranged attack. Every successful hit pulls them deeper into the sequence, allowing the next attack to become stronger and more relentless. A single miss breaks that flow completely.
traits.mechanicalFeature: Every successful ranged hit grants a cumulative +1 Power to ranged attacks and allows +1 additional ranged attack whenever X spends an Action making ranged attacks. These bonuses continue to stack while X keeps hitting. If any ranged attack misses, all accumulated bonuses are immediately removed and the sequence resets.

conditions.name: Alarmed
conditions.description: X has become acutely aware that something is wrong. Their attention sharpens as they instinctively prepare for danger.
conditions.mechanicalFeature: An Alarmed character cannot gain the Surprise Condition and gains +1 to Initiative. Alarmed ends when the danger is discovered or enough time has passed for the character to calm down, as determined by the Arbiter.

conditions.name: Surprise
conditions.description: X has been caught completely off guard and cannot properly react before the danger is already upon them.
conditions.mechanicalFeature: A character with Surprise skips their next turn. The Surprise Condition ends after that turn is skipped.

equipment.name: Stone Spear
equipment.description: A crude weapon crafted from a sharpened stone, long branch, and binding. It can stab at Engaged Range or be thrown at Near Range.

equipment.name: Stone Knife
equipment.description: A crude knife made from a knapped stone blade, small thick branch, and binding. It can be used for crafting or to cut and stab at Engaged Range.

equipment.name: Wooden Shield
equipment.description: A crude wooden shield built to intercept and deflect incoming attacks. While properly wielded the user gains +1 Defense.

equipment.name: Crude Javelin
equipment.special: Usually consumed when thrown unless recovered.
equipment.note: Values from the Character Roster; no Equipment profile yet.

equipment.name: Wooden Club
equipment.special: Stun: If Effective Power exceeds Resistance by 5 or more, the target loses 1 Speed for 1 turn.
equipment.note: Values from the Character Roster; no Equipment profile yet.

equipment.name: Spear of White Wolf
equipment.description: A Simple Stone Spear engraved with Sacred, Aerial, and Earthen Runes. The Totemic Weapon comes with the Trait, Claws of the White Wolf: When the wielder lands a Brutal Attack, the attack's damage is doubled and the wielder heals 1 Health.

equipment.name: Spear of Black Wolf
equipment.description: A Simple Stone Spear engraved with Wicked, Aerial, and Earthen Runes. The Totemic Weapon comes with the Trait, Claws of the Black Wolf: When the wielder lands a Brutal Attack, the attack's damage is doubled and the victim's Resistance is reduced by 1 until the injury caused by the attack has been healed.

equipment.name: Stones of Earthen Spears
equipment.special: Earthen Spear Stone: When activated, the stone gathers earth into a dirt spear. If the engraved stone is recovered, it can be reused.
equipment.note: Values from the Character Roster; no Equipment profile yet.

equipment.name: Wooden Staff of Cave Fire
equipment.special: Cave Fire: Allows the wielder to shape existing sources of fire. Complexity depends on the Speed invested into the task.
equipment.note: Values from the Character Roster; no Equipment profile yet.

equipment.name: Mask of the [Skill]
equipment.description: A Vulture Mask is named for the Skill engraved into it, such as Mask of the Spear Warrior, Mask of the Thrower, Mask of the Herbalist, or Mask of the Fire Starter. A mask can hold exactly one Skill. Creating one requires the soul of a living person who possesses the desired Skill, preserving the spiritual marking that forms the Skill itself. The donor's Skill Level is not inherited. A newly created mask begins that Skill at Lv1, and the Vulture must level it through their own experience. Sid Anathema can currently create these masks only up to Tier 3.

equipment.name: Jar of the Serpent
equipment.description: A crude concoction formed of a poisonous plant smashed into a thick paste carried in a small clay jar. It can coat an allied weapon five times before the jar is empty. A coating lasts for 3 rounds and allows attacks to inflict the Bitterfang Poison Condition.

equipment.name: Jar of Erupting Smoke
equipment.description: A crude contraption formed from a clay jar filled with dried leaves and irritating plant powder. The contents can be scattered into fire or hot coals to create harsh smoke. Anyone caught breathing it suffers -1 Attack for 1 round unless they escape the smoke. One use.

equipment.name: Jar of Cleansing Waters
equipment.description: A crude murky antiseptic wash made from bark and herbs. It can clean an injury, stop a worsening mundane poison from progressing, or count as basic treatment for an effect the Arbiter considers treatable. It does not restore Health by itself. One use.

characters.name: Aren
characters.bio: Aren has pushed their Brute path into an Iron Body through Apollyon's Iron Remedies. They remain a direct spear fighter, but now possess substantially greater Strength and durability.

characters.name: Sena
characters.bio: Sena has maxed the normal Swift Body Type and entered Iron Swift. Their single Iron Swift level raises Speed to 8, combining extreme action speed with Dagger Warrior training and Nimble movement.

characters.name: Doran
characters.bio: Doran's Scout path has been strengthened into an Iron Body. Their improved Speed and Toughness support a defensive spear-and-shield style, while their Investigation and Mapping theories make them one of the more observant members of the group.
characters.note: Iron Scout grants Weak Danger Premonition, but the sheet lists Doran's Traits as Flexible only. Arbiter to confirm.

characters.name: Mira
characters.bio: Mira has reached the maximum level of the balanced Advanced Body Type, giving them 4 Strength, 4 Speed, and 4 Toughness while retaining focused training with thrown weapons.

characters.name: Korr
characters.bio: Korr is the most physically developed conventional soldier in this test group. Their Iron Advanced body is highly balanced, and their growing Theory of Leadership hints at developing command ability without yet granting a mechanical bonus.

characters.name: Seeker of Safety
characters.bio: A Stable Vault Vulture whose green Earthen markings show through their sickly pale skin beneath layers of fur. They hide behind a Mask of the Spear Warrior and fight cautiously with the Spear of White Wolf.

characters.name: Seeker of Strength
characters.bio: A Malicious Vault Vulture marked by purple Wicked Essence. Darkness gathers around their physical attacks, causing weapons they wield to inflict unnaturally severe wounds. They carry a Mask of the Spear Warrior.

characters.name: Seeker of the Horizon
characters.bio: A Swift Vault Vulture covered in light-blue Aerial markings. Their Mask of the Thrower supports their ranged fighting style, while their pact rewards an uninterrupted chain of successful ranged attacks.

characters.name: Collector of Remedies
characters.otherGear: Five small clay jars on a sling: Bitterfang Paste, Bloodroot Mash, Numbreed Salve, Smokeleaf Jar, and Cleanbark Wash. Also carries a simple wooden shelf for storage and preparation.
characters.bio: The leader of this Vulture pack. Collector of Remedies relies on a Stable Vault body, a highly developed Mask of the Herbalist, and practical knowledge of plants, poisons, salves, and field treatment rather than direct combat power.

characters.name: Seeker of Warmth
characters.bio: A Radiant Vault Vulture whose yellow Infernal markings glow across their pale body. Their Mask of the Fire Starter, Pact of Combustion, and Wooden Staff of Cave Fire all center on controlling and intensifying existing flame.
